## Living abroad? We are a local workshop and you collect from us

Collect at the workshop in Kochánov, by arrangement. We deliver to Humpolec and Havlíčkův Brod.

Call Jiřina Write to us

### Family in Czechia

Buying for family in Czechia? They can collect in Kochánov or Humpolec.

Your name and a phone number or e-mail are enough. We'll reply and arrange a date.
